subject: MAP and procurement sequencing for VitalCore pilot
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@vitalcore.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: MAP + procurement timeline for VitalCore pilot

Marcus / team —

Thanks for the demo last week. We want to lock an accelerated mutual action plan (MAP) so procurement and legal can run in parallel with the evaluation. Target: pilot go-live and signature by 2026-11-30, but procurement may be the gating item.

High-level asks from our side:
- Redlines we expect from VitalCore legal (MSA/DPA) — target review by 10/26
- Security artifacts: SOC 2 Type II, data flow diagram, retention policy
- Order form details: billing entity + PO process (our procurement leads will need the cadence)

I've attached our internal procurement schedule (procurement_schedule.csv) so you can align milestones. Please propose a short MAP (milestones + owners + dates) and flag any legal/ops blockers.

Emily Chen
Director, Strategic Procurement
VitalCore Health
Attachments: procurement_schedule.csv
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@vitalcore.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + procurement timeline for VitalCore pilot

Thanks Emily — great to line this up. Draft MAP attached (proposed_map.xlsx) with milestone owners and a two-track approach so legal and procurement can run concurrently:

Summary of proposed MAP (high level):
1) Eval window (engineering + perf tests) — 2 weeks (10/20–11/02) — Owner: Redwood Eng (me)
2) Security review + artifacts delivery — 1 week (10/20–10/27) — Owner: Redwood Security (Karthik)
3) Legal redline cycle (MSA/DPA) — target first pass from Redwood by 10/21, exchange by 10/26 — Owner: Legal (Laura)
4) Order form & commercial sign-off — parallel with legal; procurement PO + GL fields confirmed by 11/09 — Owner: VitalCore procurement
5) Final execution & signature — target 11/30 (can be accelerated to 11/15 if legal closes earlier)

Immediate asks for VitalCore to avoid bottlenecks:
- Please send SOC2 report and your preferred evidence format (we can accept a redacted copy)
- Confirm billing entity and whether PO will be required on signature
- Identify procurement contact (name/email) for PO-field validation and billing address

Operational notes:
- We'll prepare a minimal order form variant to allow signature while commercial annexes are finalized if you prefer a phased sign approach.
- Karthik, can you confirm SOC2 availability and estimate time to compile DFD & retention notes?

Marcus
Sr. Enterprise Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed_map.xlsx
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@vitalcore.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + procurement timeline for VitalCore pilot

Looping in legal commentary. Marcus — I attached our initial redlines (MSA_v2_redlines.pdf) and a short DPA note. Key points:
- We can accept VitalCore's standard data residency clause with a minor edit (see pg. 4) — propose language we can ship back in a day once procurement confirms region.
- DPA: standard subprocessors list will be finalized pre-signature; we can include the list as an exhibit to speed signature.
- SLA/addendum: we recommend leaving performance SLAs at a validated appendix and completing those during the pilot acceptance window.

Requested timing from legal: please have VitalCore legal provide their redline or comments by 2026-10-26 so we can turn around a consolidated draft the same week. If VitalCore prefers, we will prepare a two-tier execution plan: (1) sign MSA + Order Form to enable pilot, (2) finalize DPA exhibit and SLA appendix within 30 days post-signature.

Quoted from Marcus earlier for visibility:
> 3) Legal redline cycle (MSA/DPA) — target first pass from Redwood by 10/21, exchange by 10/26

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: MSA_v2_redlines.pdf
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@vitalcore.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@vitalcore.com>, procure@vitalcore.com
Date: 2026-10-20T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + procurement timeline for VitalCore pilot

Thanks — this is helpful and the two-tier execution path sounds workable. Quick updates from our side:
- Procurement contact: Ravi Patel (ravi.patel@vitalcore.com) — he'll own PO cadence and billing fields.
- Security artifacts: attaching our questionnaire (VitalCore_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). We can accept a redacted SOC2 by EOD 10/22.
- Legal: we'll aim to return redlines by 10/26, but can accelerate if Redwood provides the two-tier language as a clean option for signature.

Request: could Redwood ship the minimal order form (with baseline pricing and billing entity) as a separate doc so our procurement team can validate PO fields while legal reviews MSA? That would materially shorten the path to execution — ideally enabling the 11/15 signature target Emily mentioned in our planning call.

Emily Chen
Director, Strategic Procurement
VitalCore Health
Attachments: VitalCore_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx
